period_note: Sourced from the Annual Report 2020's own 'Evaluation of quarterly performance' table (the same table that also carries the FY2019 comparator columns used separately for 2019_Q1/Q2/Q3.json). BASIS: SOLO. Every value in this report's own Dec-31-2020 column (Investment 40,021.08, Loans 213,204.68, Paid-up Capital 9,702.98, Total Shareholders' Equity 20,241.36, Total Assets 313,316.22, Off-Balance Items 165,010.62, Net Interest Income 3,190.61, Non-Interest Income 9,985.03, Operating Expenses 6,393.16, Operating Profit 6,782.48, Net Profit After Tax 2,063.64, EPS 2.13) reproduces exactly against this dataset's own independently-sourced FY2020 Solo Q4 figures (bank_financials/PREMIERBAN/quarterly/2020_Q4.json), including the CONTEMPORANEOUS (pre-restatement) Total Assets figure -- see below. This is NOT the Consolidated-vs-Solo mismatch affecting FY2022/2024/2025 -- FY2020 interim data is clean Solo, consistent with the main Q4/annual series. CROSS-CHECK PERFORMED (task requirement): the FY2021 report's own comparator column for 31-Dec-2020 within this same table was checked line-by-line against this report's own contemporaneous figures. RESTATEMENT CONFIRMED (already known): FY2021's comparator shows Total Assets of 315,723.19 for Dec-2020, not this report's own 313,316.22 -- this is the SAME restatement already documented in 2020_Q4.json's period_note (a 0.77% gap first appearing in the FY2021 five-year table); per project convention the contemporaneous 313,316.22-vintage figures are used throughout Q1-Q3 below, not the later-restated ones (Q1-Q3 2020 have not themselves been found restated anywhere -- only the FY2020 annual/Dec-31 figure was). ADDITIONAL DISCREPANCY FOUND: the FY2021 report's comparator column also shows Mar-31-2020 Total Shareholders' Equity of 18,604.45, versus this report's own contemporaneous 19,231.65 (used below). 18,604.45 is suspiciously identical to FY2019's own Dec-31 equity value, strongly suggesting a one-off transcription error in the FY2021 report's own comparative table (it appears someone copied the wrong row) rather than a genuine restatement -- Dec-2020/Sep-2020/Jun-2020 equity all reproduce exactly across both reports, only the Mar-2020 cell is anomalous. Flagged for transparency; not used (this report's own contemporaneous 19,231.65 is used). EPS ALSO DIFFERS in the FY2021 comparator for every 2020 quarter (Mar 0.59 vs this report's 0.62; Jun 1.00 vs 1.12; Sep 1.53 vs 1.65; Dec 1.98 vs 2.13) -- consistent with a further retroactive bonus-share EPS restatement (same mechanism as the FY2019 EPS note above); contemporaneous, not-yet-restated EPS values from THIS report are used below, per project convention.
